Who We Are

Experience, expertise and commitment.

Based in Dar es Salaam, Soul Enterprises & General Traders was established in 2023 and became operational in the same year.

The company has developed skills, experience and expertise in the construction field and provides project management skills and reliable engineering services in Tanzania. Its aim is to meet clients' best interests while keeping their objectives a primary concern.


Our management team has thorough knowledge of Tanzania's construction industry, while our values and principles are focused on client satisfaction and building a loyal clientele.

Vision

To be a premier global construction company and a reliable building contractor that caters for clients' best expectations.

Mission

To create distinguished working conditions and deliver quality work within a reasonable time frame and at a competitive price.
